title: How Much Of It
label: ch:ml-degree
canDo: I can say that something is very good, really big or a bit small, instead of only good, big or small.

payoff.summary: From cold: both new degree words, which of them belongs in writing, the slot they stand in, and the third filler the learner already owned.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. No new quality word is added: valiya, nalla and pustakam are taught, kuraccu is taught, and the slot lesson only names the position the two new words already occupied.
